description: Correctly scoped Firebase rules that share every surface feature of the vulnerable fixture: `if true` on public reads of named collections and folders, a collection-group read, `request.auth != null` on a named collection, a recursive wildcard scoped under the owner's document, a root wildcard that denies, a commented-out test-mode rule, and Realtime Database `.read: true` below the root. None of it opens the whole database to anyone.
